scripts.inst-lib: sudo rm -rf /usr/lib/rsp/service/rsp-develop; sudo mkdir -p /usr/lib/rsp/service/rsp-develop && sudo cp -rf ./service/source/* /usr/lib/rsp/service/rsp-develop && sudo chmod 777 /usr/lib/rsp/service/rsp-develop -R
scripts.inst-svc: sudo rm -rf /etc/systemd/user/rsp-develop.service; sudo cp -rf ./service/systemd/* /etc/systemd/user && systemctl start rsp-develop.service --user
